pages.title: Portable Furnace
pages.text: A tiny magical furnace that works from your inventory. It slowly smelts items without fuel, taking twice as long as ordinary smelting.

$(bold)Changing its mood$()$(br)Right-click the hakkero while it is in your inventory to cycle through $(bold)OFF → Smoker → Furnace → Blast Furnace$(). Each mode accepts the recipes of that type.$(br2)The hakkero has four internal slots. It draws materials from nearby inventory slots and places finished results into other nearby slots, so leave room around it for items to move.
